page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2ne.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 4 physical cores and 4 vCPUs with a single thread per core configuration. The hardware profile includes 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a resource density of 8.0 GB per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of a 959 GB SSD, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 2 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations indicate that the ecs.i2ne.xlarge operates in the lower performance tiers. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests place the instance in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show a similar trend, with read-only large block memory bandwidth scoring in the bottom 10% (20.18 GB/sec) and write large block bandwidth in the bottom 25% (18.64 GB/sec). Computational workloads like gzip compression and bzip3 multi-threaded decompression also fall into the bottom 10% to 25% performance brackets.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its high local storage capacity and memory allocation relative to its lower-tier processing speeds and memory bandwidth. While database operations on Passmark score in the bottom 10% (1081.7 operations), the 959 GB local SSD and 32.0 GB RAM make it suitable for workloads requiring local data caching, lightweight database hosting, or memory-intensive tasks that do not demand high CPU throughput.
